parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the bastion host that you want to enable.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the ID of the bastion host.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the bastion host.

parameters.name: SecurityGroupIds
parameters.description: An array consisting of the IDs of security groups to which the bastion host is added.

parameters.name: VswitchId
parameters.description: The ID of the vSwitch to which the bastion host belongs.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost start-instance --instance-id bastionhost-cn-78v1gh0000 --vswitch-id vsw-bp1xfwzzfti0kjbf0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --security-group-ids sg-bp1aiupc4yjqgmm0000 --client-security-group-ids sg-uf65hnzqj9ww1x0000 --slave-vswitch-id vsw-9dpspfku7gita0000 --enable-portal-private-access true --region cn-hangzhou
